ينقطع (form VII)
# يَنْقَطِعُ (yanqaṭiʕu) /jan.qa.tˤi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
# يَنْقَطِعَ (yanqaṭiʕa) /jan.qa.tˤi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
# يَنْقَطِعْ (yanqaṭiʕ) /jan.qa.tˤiʕ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
